status: explicit one-loop toy descent and shared-modulus sensitivity theorem; not a complete E6 spectrum or a nonperturbative QCD calculation

conventions.leadingThresholdMatching: alpha^{-1} is continuous at each declared mass; finite and higher-loop threshold terms are deliberately omitted

e6ToyDescent.chain: E6 -> Spin(10) x U(1)_psi -> SU(5) -> Standard Model -> SU(3)_color
e6ToyDescent.declaredContent: three chiral 27_F families; below E6 breaking retain six Standard Model Dirac color flavors plus three vectorlike Dirac color triplets from the three Spin(10) 10 branches; take the exotic triplets degenerate at M_X; omit colored scalars
e6ToyDescent.warning: This content is a transparent minimal color-sector toy, not a claimed realistic E6 Higgs vacuum, doublet-triplet solution, or full threshold spectrum.

benchmark.interpretation: The near-QCD-sized output is engineered by the declared boundary data and is not an E6 prediction.

analyticDerivatives.explanation: The first derivative is -2 pi/b3 with b3=9. The second is (b_below-b_above)/b3=(7-5)/9.

nondegenerateExoticMassLaw.formula: d ln Lambda3/d ln M_Xi = (2/3)/9 = 2/27 for each vectorlike Dirac triplet
nondegenerateExoticMassLaw.decision: Splitting the three masses at fixed product leaves the one-loop Lambda3 unchanged; higher-loop and finite terms require further model data.

finiteMatchingShiftLaw.definition: Delta is the total additive shift to alpha_3^{-1} transported to the low-energy matching equation
finiteMatchingShiftLaw.decision: An unfixed order-one matching correction carries another factor-of-two ambiguity at this order.

sensitivity.decision: Neither the E6 branching rule nor the number of 27s fixes alphaU, M_X, finite matching terms, or the symmetry-breaking spectrum, so Lambda_QCD remains exponentially sensitive to free boundary and threshold data.

embeddingIndexAudit.finiteReason: Spin(5) cannot embed in SU(3) by dimension; an SU(3) embedding in SO(5) would require a faithful five-dimensional real orthogonal representation, while the smallest nontrivial real representation carrying the complex fundamental has real dimension six.
embeddingIndexAudit.commonParentDoesNotSuffice: Canonical subgroup normalization in a common simple parent can impose a tree-level boundary relation, but unequal spectra and thresholds immediately generate unequal running unless an exact symmetry maps the complete quantum theories.

spin5Su3Coincidence.decision: C_A equality is an accidental pure-gauge one-loop coincidence, not a protected Casimir or embedding-index scale law.

sharedModulusTest.decision: A common v cancels from the ratio but does not predict it. A boundary condition or dynamical fixed relation for both g(v) and xi is indispensable.
